page.overview:
Who is Ghost?

The is a spirit who starts haunting after the completion of the , wanting him to take it to its house. As cannot enter while the follows him, he must help it in order to enter . Once brings it to the north of , the examines it before saying it is essentially unchanged from what it was when it was alive. The then asks to bring it to its grave, which is located in the near the . Once there, the thanks and tells him to look inside one of the in its house to find a . The does not appear until after has fulfilled the 's requests.

In , if approaches the 's grave after returning it there, the will appear and take a .

In Link's Awakening (Nintendo Switch), the Secret Seashell inside its house can be found at any time. Instead, the Ghost rewards Link with a Fairy Bottle after returning it to its grave.

The is an evil spirit that haunts at the . can save by sucking the up with the . If does not save from the before arriving at the via , will die and both he and the will disappear. This renders the unobtainable, as it is a reward given to by if he is saved.
